title: Ink for a Master
description: Prove that the Overlord's spellcraft has moved beyond mere access to apparatus. Reach Iron's own legendary-ink milestone; Questlog observes the native accomplishment and records only the REIGN-level conclusion that active spellcraft is now an established discipline of the reign.
description_completed: Active mana spellcraft is established as a mature discipline of the reign without replacing Iron's deeper native progression.
